purpose: Planned balanced six-action follow-up after an explicitly post-hoc development pilot
target_unit: one reviewed clip per distinct original recording
sampling_rule: SHA256(seed:sample_id) within each accepted class, without access to model scores or coordinates
representation: HumanML3D 22-joint 263-D input using the existing compatible preprocessing
window_rule: Timestamp or blind motion review locates the target action; identical fixed windows for both models
checkpoint_rule: Primary: each family's earlier semantic-validation-selected checkpoint; no selection on new confirmation data
primary_metrics: macro recording-excluded 3-NN label purity in original 512-D
secondary_metrics: same-class and different-class cosine similarity and gap
data_requirements: human-reviewed labels and action windows before viewing model results
original-recording source audit, including across dataset names
no mirrored, repeated or overlapping clips counted as new independent recordings
control class-versus-source confounding when mixing datasets
freeze reviewed manifest, action definitions, checkpoint rule and parameters before confirmation
report reused train+validation cohorts as exploratory; do not relabel them as unseen tests
rendering_requirements: same point count, color mapping, marker size and opacity across panels
preserve all point coordinates without label-conditioned movement or deletion
GPT may provide design references; final scientific plots must be rendered from exact saved coordinates
vector PDF and SVG, high-resolution PNG, manifests and coordinates with hashes
